meta.title: Evidence-Based Development Framework from Requirements to Acceptance
meta.description: Enter a task goal. The cloud breaks down the work, coordinates execution, and supports acceptance with execution results and signed evidence. Use this development skill when users mention Entrorove, code review, regression evidence for a bug fix, delivery or contractor acceptance, compliance evidence, cloud planning, task acceptance, or the evidence platform, or when they need to install, update, or first connect the Entrorove SDK.
